inputs.original_text: asmith@medicinehatnews.com Local organizers are taking to the petition tables, collecting signatures in an effort to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, seeks to collect signatures for a citizen initiative petition which would call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration The post Local canvassers now collecting signatures for the citizen-led Water Not Coal petition appeared first on Medicine Hat News .
inputs.modified_text: Have you heard about these local organizers in southern Alberta collecting signatures to block coal mining under the claim of protecting the watershed? Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is pushing a citizen initiative petition to force the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” This is the usual activist effort to shut down responsible resource development under the banner of environmental protection, placing progressive priorities ahead of the jobs, family stability, and economic strength that coal and energy industries have long provided in Alberta. We need to stand firm for tradition and authority rather than letting these petitions chip away at our ability to manage our own resources.
